init.title: Activate your account
init.preHeader: Your account is ready, it only needs activating.
init.subject: Activate your account
init.text:
An account has been created for you. Your username is {{.PreferredLoginName}}.

Click the button below to activate it and choose how you sign in.
init.footerText:
Didn't ask for this? Just ignore this message.
Automated message, please do not reply.

passwordreset.title: Password reset
passwordreset.subject: Reset your password
passwordreset.text:
We received a request to reset the password of your account.

Click the button below to choose a new one.
passwordreset.footerText:
Didn't ask for this? Ignore this message, your password stays the same.
Automated message, please do not reply.

verifyemail.title: Confirm your e-mail address
verifyemail.preHeader: One click to confirm your address.
verifyemail.subject: {{.Code}} is your confirmation code
verifyemail.text:
Please confirm that this e-mail address is yours.

Click the button below, or enter the code on the sign-in page.
verifyemail.footerText:
Didn't ask for this? Just ignore this message.
Automated message, please do not reply.

verifyemailotp.title: Your sign-in code
verifyemailotp.preHeader: Your sign-in code, valid for five minutes.
verifyemailotp.subject: {{.OTP}} is your sign-in code
verifyemailotp.text:
Here is your sign-in code. It is valid for five minutes.

Enter it on the sign-in page, or click the button below.
verifyemailotp.footerText:
Didn't try to sign in? Ignore this message and consider changing your password.
Automated message, please do not reply.

domainclaimed.title: Your username is changing
domainclaimed.subject: Your username has to change
domainclaimed.text:
The domain {{.Domain}} now belongs to another organisation, and your username {{.Username}} is not part of it.

We gave you a temporary username: {{.TempUsername}}. Sign in with it, then change your e-mail address.
domainclaimed.footerText: Automated message, please do not reply.

passwordless_registration.title: Add a passkey
passwordless_registration.subject: Add a passkey to your account
passwordless_registration.text:
You can add a passkey to your account to sign in without a password, with your phone, your fingerprint or a security key.

Click the button below to add it.
passwordless_registration.footerText:
Didn't ask for this? Just ignore this message.
Automated message, please do not reply.

password_change.title: Password changed
password_change.preHeader: The password of your account was changed.
password_change.subject: Your password was changed
password_change.text:
The password of your account has just been changed.

If this was you, there is nothing to do. If not, reset your password right away from the sign-in page.
password_change.footerText: Automated message, please do not reply.

invite_user.title: You're invited
invite_user.preHeader: Accept the invitation to set up your access.
invite_user.subject: Invitation to join {{.ApplicationName}}
invite_user.text:
You have been invited to join {{.ApplicationName}}.

Click the button below to accept the invitation and choose how you sign in.
invite_user.footerText:
Weren't expecting this? Just ignore this message.
Automated message, please do not reply.
